steps.title: Four legs. Eight joints.
steps.narration: Four legs, eight joints. This fixed-body kinematic model reveals how a small quadruped moves.

steps.title: Two joints place one foot.
steps.narration: Two joints place each foot. The hip swings the leg; the knee adjusts reach.

steps.title: Lift. Sweep. Return.
steps.narration: One foot lifts, sweeps forward, then returns low. Joint angles follow the same path.

steps.title: Diagonal legs move together.
steps.narration: Diagonal legs move together. The other pair follows half a cycle later.

steps.title: Alternate the low phase.
steps.narration: During the low phase, one pair returns while the other swings forward.

steps.title: Reveal the structure. Reassemble.
steps.narration: Separate the modules. See the joints and links, then bring the mechanism together.
